title: Harvest Load Maintenance Checklist Form
subtitle: Harvest Load route the work, prepare controls, record tasks and parts, test the result, manage unresolved conditions, and authorize return to use.
description: An original, workflow-complete harvest load maintenance checklist covering identity and routing, domain observations and evidence, accountable decisions, exceptions and escalation, and completion handoff without replacing qualified judgment.
use_case: Use for scheduled or corrective maintenance that needs task evidence, measurements, parts traceability, function checks, restrictions, and handoff. The record is owned by the harvest and shipping owner and closes only after evidence, exceptions, disposition, and the next accountable handoff are documented.

sections.title: Harvest Load maintenance routing
sections.guidance: Identify the work, subject, assigned person, and review owner.

blocks.label: Maintenance Checklist identity and routing
blocks.guidance: Assign one owner and use the same record ID in attachments and follow-up.

blocks.label: Harvest Lot Or Outbound Load identity
blocks.guidance: Preserve the identifiers used by the controlling farm, facility, or partner record.

sections.title: Harvest Load work preparation
sections.guidance: Record instructions, condition, controls, and parts before work.

blocks.label: Pre-work review and controls
items: Field, crop, harvest lot, and crew were recorded
Start, finish, and load departure times were captured
Container, pallet, bin, or package IDs were assigned
Count, gross, tare, and net measures were reconciled as applicable
Product condition and temperature were noted under the facility plan
Transport unit, seal, driver, and destination were recorded
Rejected, held, reworked, or diverted product remained identifiable
Harvest, packing, and shipping references were linked

sections.title: Harvest Load maintenance tasks
sections.guidance: Record completed tasks separately from measurements and findings.

blocks.label: Harvest Load task checklist
items: Harvester or load equipment identity was recorded
Energy-control and cleaning status followed site procedure
Product-contact surfaces and collection areas were examined
Blades, belts, chains, conveyors, and guards were observed
Hydraulic lines, fluids, and leak evidence were checked
Scales, counters, printers, scanners, and labelers were checked
Bins, pallets, containers, and fastening systems were reviewed
Lights, controls, indicators, and alerts were function-checked
Parts, repairs, sanitation release, and restrictions were linked
Test run and return-to-harvest decision were documented

sections.title: Harvest Load parts and service evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve material, service, and removed-part traceability.

blocks.label: Work performed, deviations from plan, and supporting references

sections.title: Harvest Load function test and decision
sections.guidance: Separate the test evidence from return-to-use authorization.

blocks.label: Function and handback evidence
items: Harvest Load before-and-after results support the recorded status
Tasks, measurements, parts, and outside service are documented
Function testing is separate from return-to-use authorization
Restrictions and unfinished work have owners and due points
Qualified review was obtained where work or disposition exceeds authority

sections.title: Harvest Load unresolved conditions
sections.guidance: Preserve restrictions and route decisions beyond the maintainer’s authority.

blocks.label: Maintenance authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records harvest and load evidence; it does not certify product condition, food safety, weight, or transport suitability. Hold exceptions and route release or disposition to the authorized owner under applicable plans.

blocks.label: Harvest Load unresolved-condition triggers
items: Field, lot, container, load, or seal identity mismatch
Count, weight, scale, or document discrepancy
Product condition, damage, or foreign-material concern
Temperature, cooling, delay, or capacity exception
Transport, destination, receiver, or route change
Held, rejected, diverted, or commingled product gap

blocks.label: Restriction, immediate action, owner, due point, and final disposition

sections.title: Harvest Load maintenance closeout
sections.guidance: Transfer restrictions, next service, and evidence to operations.

blocks.label: Harvest Load open actions and limitations
blocks.guidance: Carry forward every item that is not fully resolved at closeout.

blocks.label: Harvest Load handoff confirmations
items: Work, measurements, parts, and removed material were reconciled
Restrictions and unfinished work were transferred to operations
Next maintenance, inspection, or verification point was assigned
Harvest Load return-to-use handback was acknowledged
Work records, manuals, photos, and service evidence were filed
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items remain part of the open handoff.

blocks.label: Final outcome, remaining limits, communications, and acceptance notes
